summary.summary: Example Summit Print Works Inc is applying for coverage on 1 commercial printing plant in PA, built in 1962, with a total insured value of $10,000,000 and a requested effective date of 2027-03-15. The submission includes application.pdf, broker_email.txt, locations.csv and loss_runs_scan.pdf. Three checks passed: the applicant name and effective date are present and consistent, the declared count of 1 location matches the schedule, and the $10,000,000 total insured value is within the $10,000,000 authority limit. The sprinkler check was flagged because the applicant answered No to automatic sprinklers. The loss history check is unknown because loss_runs_scan.pdf has no selectable text and may be an unreadable loss runs report, and the number of loss history years is missing, so the submission is marked NEEDS_REVIEW and is ready for human review only.
